concept: Where the page sits in the hierarchy: underlined links to each level above, a quiet chevron between, the current page last in semibold.

default_to_avoid.pattern: blue links separated by slashes (the common breadcrumb)
default_to_avoid.why_not: blue is a hue the system does not own

derivation.consequence: the scene supplies the hue; the system owns no hue of its own, only white at opacities and one ink, and colour appears only where it states a status or marks a diagram
derivation.form: links are the text colour with an underline, never blue

derivation.consequence: selected and pressed states change shape or add a mark (a check, a ring), never only colour
derivation.form: the current page is semibold and not a link

derivation.consequence: every target is at least 44px in its smaller dimension or has a 44px hit area
derivation.form: each link is a 44px target, and the trail wraps on a phone

variants.reason: A follows Link (no hue). B brings blue. C reads as buttons.

root.why: the trail in the label size, the same in every theme and on every scene

list.why: the levels in a row that wraps, the same in every theme and on every scene

crumb.why: one level with its separator, the same in every theme and on every scene

sep.why: a quiet chevron in secondary text between levels

link.why: a link to a level above, a 44px target

current.why: the current page in semibold, not a link

hover.why: the underline firms up under the pointer, the same in every theme and on every scene

focus-visible.why: the shared focus ring on a link, the same in every theme and on every scene

@media forced-colors: active.why: in forced colours the system draws the link, the current page and the focus ring so every part stays findable
